messages:
alisha: Heads-up — after the role_schema migration last night, grants for the "privileged" role aren't showing up in audit logs for ~10% of attempts. Seen across Dedicated and Hosted. Suspect ordering vs KMS rotation. :eyes:

ingrid: Do we have a repro? sample user id + grant SQL + any error?

alisha: Paste SQL:
```
BEGIN;
UPDATE roles SET perms = perms || '{"impersonate_service":true}' WHERE name='privileged';
COMMIT;
```
No DB errors. But the audit table has no entries for grant_event for those user_ids. snippet:
```
2026-03-18T02:12:43Z INFO grant_api grant succeeded (role=privileged user=team-service-123) status=200
```
weird: status=200 but no audit row.

matt: status=200 but missing audit row means the grant path didn't call audit insertion OR audit insertion failed silently. Check app logs around "audit_writer" and KMS errors. Any KMS logs at same time?

alisha: KMS log shows rotation job completed 02:11:00Z, then a spike of transient kms:encrypt errors 02:11:05-02:12:00. sample:
```
kms-service rotate: rotation_id=rot-20260318-1 status=complete
kms-client encrypt error: code=EAGAIN msg="transient ENCRYPT_FAIL" ctx="audit_writer"
```

rbac-bot: alert: 10 failed audit writes for role=privileged between 02:11:05 and 02:12:00. Trace id: tr-8a3c

devops: Likely a race between rotation and audit_writer caching KMS client. If the audit_writer caches a KMS client handle that's invalid post-rotation, encrypt will fail but app returns 200 if grant path doesn't treat encrypt failure as fatal. Quick check: what's audit_writer behavior? Does it swallow exceptions?

matt: I looked at the code — audit_writer calls kms.encrypt inside try/catch and logs error but returns success to grant path. So bug: non-fatal KMS errors lead to silent audit loss. We should 1) change to fail grant if audit write fails for privileged roles, or 2) queue audit write for retries and make grant path return 202. For now, what's the minimal fix?

ingrid: Minimal hotfix: enable retry queue for audit writes + emit 5xx if audit write ultimately fails after X retries within request window. Need prod patch and config flag. Also backfill missing audits.

nate: I can run a backfill job scanning grant events from auth_logs and insert audit rows where missing. Two questions: a) can we safely re-encrypt with new KMS key? b) do we record original timestamp?

alisha: Yes — we should re-encrypt using current key; add metadata field 'replayed_at' and 'original_event_ts' so auditors can see it's backfilled. Also add "root_cause=KMS-rotation-race" tag.

devops: Rolling canary plan: patch audit_writer in prod/stage to enable retry queue and non-silent failures for privileged role; promote to canary region for 20 minutes; monitor audit ingestion metric (audit_write_success_rate) and errors. If green, promote.

rbac-bot: deploy-job: audit-writer v1.4.3-hotfix deployed to canary-us-west at 2067894700 by devops. :rocket:

alisha: Backfill started 2067894800 job_id=bf-2067894800, scanning 02:00-03:00 window. small expected insert ~1200 rows. Posting backfill SQL for review:
```
INSERT INTO audit_events(event_type, payload, created_at, meta)
SELECT 'grant', encrypt_payload(payload_json), original_ts, json_build_object('replayed_at', now(), 'note', 'backfill KMS rotation race')
FROM auth_grants g
LEFT JOIN audit_events a ON a.ref_id = g.id
WHERE a.id IS NULL AND g.role='privileged' AND g.created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-18 02:00:00' AND '2026-03-18 03:00:00';
```

matt: nit: wrap encrypt_payload in try/catch in job and if encrypt fails, write to dead_letter table for manual handling. Also make sure we add "replay_notice" audit flag.

ingrid: Added to postmortem draft. Also escalate to compliance: compliance@redwood for sign-off on replayed events.

sec-bot: compliance-notify: incident created INC-2026-0318-RBAC-AUDIT; severity=P2; owner=ingrid.

alisha: Backfill finished 2067895300 job_id=bf-2067894800 result=ok inserted=1187 requeued=0 dead_letter=0. Verified sample entries in audit UI. :thumbsup:

devops: Hotfix promoted to primary at 2067895380. Will schedule proper code change to fail-fast on audit write for privileged roles in next patch.

matt: Follow-up actions: 1) add unit tests for KMS error handling 2) change audit_writer config defaults 3) run global backfill for other windows 4) update runbook.

ingrid: I'll write the postmortem and link to incident channel. Thanks everyone. :heart:

alisha: huge thanks. Closing thread once postmortem links added.
